result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.trav_in_edge()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Traverse from selected nodes to inbound edges. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L6593-L6629){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.trav_in_edge() ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} From the currently selected nodes, moves to all edges where the selected nodes are targets (inbound edges). The current node selection is cleared and replaced with an edge selection. For directed graphs, selects edges where to=selected_node. For undirected graphs, selects all edges incident to selected nodes. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [Graph]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Self for method chaining. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} ::: {#4031cd5e .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec graph = ec.Graph(directed=True) graph.add_node(label="A") graph.add_node(label="B") graph.add_node(label="C") graph.add_edge(source="A", target="C") graph.add_edge(source="B", target="C") node_c_id = graph.get_id_from_label("C") graph.select_nodes_by_id([node_c_id]).trav_in_edge() # Returns 2 len(graph.get_selected_edge_ids()) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` 2 ``` ::: :::
